name: nayana_bench_human_annotated
description: A human-annotated dataset providing human judgments on model outputs to evaluate response quality and alignment with human preferences. It aggregates human labels over a set of prompts/tasks to enable benchmarking of generative models' output quality. The dataset is intended for human-evaluation-style assessments rather than purely automated evaluation.
reputation: A niche, community-contributed human-annotated benchmark on Hugging Face with limited but useful adoption for human-evaluation studies.
